lines.zh: 我摆着长尾，穿过一片水草。
lines.en: I swing my long tail through a bed of weeds.
swims to shore to feed
slaps water with tail
swims swiftly through water
spits bubbles to find prey
dives for fish

lines.zh: 甩动身体驱赶其他鱼类
lines.en: swishes body to disperse fish
glides in water
makes a squeaky noise
slaps water with fins

lines.zh: 鳍脚拨开水草，悠然前行。
lines.en: Flippers part the weeds as I swim.

lines.zh: 长嘴划过水面，留下一道痕。
lines.en: My long snout leaves a line on the water.
I ride the warm current to the shallows.
A flick of my tail, into the reef gap.
floats quietly on surface
occasionally turns body
stretches lazily
stares at distant water
drifts slowly looking for food
The ichthyosaur wiggles its tail and squeaks.
occasionally looks up
taps surface gently with tail
wanders idly

lines.zh: 水草从我嘴边流过，我不动。
lines.en: Weeds drift past my mouth and I do not move.
I float and watch the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 阳光透过水层，暖着我的背。
lines.en: Sunlight warms my back through the water.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，听远处的响动。
lines.en: I hold still and listen far away.
I doze in a crack of the reef.

lines.zh: 你在岸上走，我在水下跟着。
lines.en: You walk the bank and I follow beneath the water.

lines.zh: 我这一声吱叫，水面都听得见。
lines.en: My squeak carries all the way to the surface.
A squeak, and I turn to you.
This mouth of mine only squeaks.
I squeak and the water surface splits.
swims toward player

lines.zh: 你的手在水面投下影子，我盯着。
lines.en: Your hand casts a shadow on the water and I watch it.
nervously turns to look at player
approaches to check on player

lines.zh: 水面的影子停在你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow on the water stops at your feet.
I squeaked. Did you hear?
Two legs in the water: strange.

lines.zh: 我感到我的鳞片在裂开。
lines.en: My scales are cracking.

lines.zh: 疼痛从我的身体蔓延开来。
lines.en: Pain is spreading through my body.

lines.zh: 我被自己的尾巴绊倒了。
lines.en: I tripped over my own tail.
My wounds are bleeding.

lines.zh: 我需要找到一个更安全的地方。
lines.en: I need a safer place.
My strength is fading.
Such a painful moment.
My scales are darkening.
The pain is making it hard to breathe.
I need to rest.

lines.zh: 你靠近了，但我不会轻易放弃。
lines.en: You're close, but I won't give up easily.

lines.zh: 你的食物，也是我的食物。
lines.en: Your food, mine too.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻，你会后悔的。
lines.en: Enjoy it, you'll regret it.
Stay away, don't tempt me.

lines.zh: 你来得太及时了，但我会抓住你的。
lines.en: You're just in time, but I'll catch you.

lines.zh: 我只会吱吱叫，别逼我咬。
lines.en: I only squeak; don't make me bite.

lines.zh: 我的耐心有限，不要考验我。
lines.en: I have limited patience, don't test me.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼饵，比鱼群香。
lines.en: The bait in your hand smells better than any school.
The closer you are, the more dangerous it is.
Don't try to get near my nest.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，准备战斗。
lines.en: You blocked my path, prepare to fight.
Collide with me, and you'll pay the price.

lines.zh: 你的船底擦过我的背，我甩尾。
lines.en: Your hull grazes my back and I snap my tail.
You hit too hard, I'll retaliate.
You disrupted my hunt.
I'm large, be careful.

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以伤害我。
lines.en: Your strength is not enough to harm me.
Collide with me, and you'll be hurt.

lines.zh: 我在你腿边打了个转，尾巴拍你。
lines.en: I turn beside your legs and slap you with my tail.

lines.zh: 你的木桨撞上我的吻部，弹开了。
lines.en: Your oar hits my snout and bounces off.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，繁衍后代。
lines.en: Find my mate, to reproduce.

lines.zh: 它绕着我的尾巴转，我就懂了。
lines.en: It circles my tail, and I understand.
My mate, I'll protect you.
Mating makes us stronger.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣，来繁衍。
lines.en: I need a mate to reproduce.
Mating is the only choice.
Mate with me, we can survive.

lines.zh: 交配，我们的后代会更强。
lines.en: Mate, our offspring will be stronger.
Mating, let's survive together.

lines.zh: 浅滩的水暖，正适合成家。
lines.en: The shallows are warm; good for a nest.
Gulp awake.
Open wide.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶起一块亮石头，玩一会。
lines.en: I nudge a bright stone up with my snout and play with it.
Stare at you.
Throat rumbles.
Swim closer.
Whispering sound.
Look around.

lines.zh: 我叼住漂来的树枝，拖回巢下。
lines.en: I take a drifting branch in my mouth and drag it under my ledge.
I bite down and drag it under.

lines.zh: 鱼群一乱，我就知道谁在下面。
lines.en: When the school scatters, I know who is below.
Fire in eyes.
Creep closer.
Tail tightens.

lines.zh: 我吱一声，就没人敢靠近。
lines.en: One squeak of mine keeps them away.
The school moved; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我看见了它的鳍，就在礁石后。
lines.en: I see its fin, just behind the reef.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声吱叫。
lines.en: A squeal rolls out of my throat.
Ready for the kill.
Target and aim.
I have spotted something that moves.
A splash, and I turn toward it.
You have waded into my hunting ground.
The fish scatter; the target is you.

lines.zh: 我把长嘴对准了那条鱼。
lines.en: I line my long snout up with that fish.

lines.zh: 水面折的光落进我眼里，很冷。
lines.en: Reflected light falls into my eyes, cold and green.

lines.zh: 前方那道白影，是我的鱼。
lines.en: That pale shape ahead is my fish.
Attack starts.

lines.zh: 鱼龙的吱叫，水里传得很远。
lines.en: An ichthyosaur's squeak carries far in water.
Nearby target.
Target and attack.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍压低，贴着水底滑行。
lines.en: I lower my dorsal fin and skim along the bottom.
Enemy locked.
I squeak as I dart in.
I slip beneath and around you.

lines.zh: 水流会先告诉我要往哪。
lines.en: The current tells me where to go.
I aim my snout at your ankle.

lines.zh: 水里吱一声，就是我在叫你。
lines.en: A squeak in the water means I'm calling.

lines.zh: 水面下的影子越来越长。
lines.en: My shadow under the water grows long.

lines.zh: 发出低吼，张嘴咬向敌人。
lines.en: Low growl, open mouth to bite.
Tail swipe, push back intruders.

lines.zh: 用利爪攻击，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Attack with claws, hiss.

lines.zh: 喷出一束水流，淹没对手。
lines.en: Spray a jet of water, drown opponent.

lines.zh: 咬住猎物，发出痛苦的呻吟。
lines.en: Grip prey, emit pained groan.
Headbutt, make a dull sound.

lines.zh: 尖牙刺入肉中，发出咔嚓声。
lines.en: Sharp teeth pierce flesh, snap.
Body swing, fling prey.

lines.zh: 用尾巴鞭打，发出啪啪声。
lines.en: Tail whip, crack.

lines.zh: 用颚部夹住，发出咂咂声。
lines.en: Clamp with jaws, make smacking sound.
My long jaws close and hold.
I roll and churn the water.
My tail sweeps you aside.
Fine teeth pierce through flesh.

lines.zh: 从蛋中孵化，发出吱吱声。
lines.en: Hatch from egg, make azz azz sound.
Dive into water, seek food.

lines.zh: 在珊瑚礁旁孵化，发出咂咂声。
lines.en: Hatch near coral reef, make smacking sound.

lines.zh: 在深海中孵化，发出吱吱声。
lines.en: Hatch in deep sea, make azz azz sound.

lines.zh: 在夜幕下孵化，发出咂咂声。
lines.en: Hatch under night, make smacking sound.

lines.zh: 在沙堆中孵化，发出吱吱声。
lines.en: Hatch in sand, make azz azz sound.

lines.zh: 在岩洞中孵化，发出咂咂声。
lines.en: Hatch in cave, make smacking sound.

lines.zh: 在海底遗迹孵化，发出吱吱声。
lines.en: Hatch in underwater ruins, make azz azz sound.

lines.zh: 在珊瑚丛中孵化，发出咂咂声。
lines.en: Hatch among corals, make smacking sound.
I hatch from an egg in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我在浅海里叫了一声，你听见吗？
lines.en: I called in the shallows; did you hear?
Behind the reef, I open my eyes.
I flap my fins and learn to swim.

lines.zh: 这片海，从此有我的吱叫。
lines.en: These waters will hear my squeak now.
The tide carried me here.

lines.zh: 海草间多了一个小影子。
lines.en: One more small shadow in the kelp.
I break the shell and swim down.

lines.zh: 史前海域里多了一个住客。
lines.en: A new tenant in a prehistoric sea.
Fire burns my skin!
A fish-lizard on dry ground hurts.

lines.zh: 我冲上水面吸气，又被浪压下去。
lines.en: I break the surface for air and a wave pushes me back down.

lines.zh: 炸药在水里爆开，我被掀上浅滩。
lines.en: The charge goes off underwater and throws me onto the shallows.

lines.zh: 骨刺穿过我的鳍，拔不出来。
lines.en: A bone spike through my fin won't come out.

lines.zh: 紫色的符光在水里散开，我发软。
lines.en: Purple rune-light spreads through the water and I go weak.

lines.zh: 鱼群散了三天，我游得很慢。
lines.en: The fish have scattered for three days and I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，整片池子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and the whole pool lights up.
Infinite darkness devoured me.
